title: Focus Group Discussion Guide – Innovation Adoption and Constraints (Nigerian SMEs)
purpose: Elicit group-level norms, consensus, and contested views on constraints, enablers, and strategies when adopting innovation.
ground_rules: One person at a time, respect all views
No need to agree; differences are valuable

prompts: Briefly introduce your business and your most recent innovation adoption.
What problem were you trying to solve?
Which constraints are most binding in your sector (power, broadband, finance, skills, policy, trust)?
How do these constraints interact? For example, power affecting broadband equipment or cold-chain?
activities: Constraint ranking: participants vote on top three constraints
Causal mapping: draw arrows between constraints and outcomes

prompts: What helped you move forward (peer learning, vendor support, platforms, government programs)?
Share specific tactics that worked in your context.
How did adoption affect performance (sales, costs, delivery times, rejection rates)?
What unintended consequences emerged (dependency, churn, cybersecurity, compliance costs)?
Which policies or ecosystem changes would most unlock adoption in your sector?
What is feasible in the next 12 months vs. longer-term?

closing.thanks: Thank you for sharing. We will synthesize the themes and return a summary to the group, if desired.
